name: Holy Basil Purple
summary: Holy Basil Purple carries a Grade C rating — limited evidence. Recorded activity centres on inflammatory signaling modulation, oxidative stress modulation and metabolic regulation, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. Noted cautions include pregnancy/breastfeeding without clinician supervision and known allergy to the plant/family.
description: Holy Basil Purple botanical profile with evidence, safety, and practical fit.
safetyNotes: REPRODUCTIVE SAFETY GAP: Animal studies of holy basil report reduced pregnancy success at high doses; whether this applies to purple-cultivar extracts or to humans is unknown. Avoid medicinal use when pregnant or trying to conceive, and avoid while breastfeeding pending safety data. Potential glucose-related interactions remain a precaution.
contraindications: Pregnancy or conception planning: avoid medicinal purple holy basil; human/cultivar-specific risk unconfirmed
interactions: Potential interaction concern with antidiabetic medicines
use clinician review for high-dose extracts or chronic use.

sources.note: Do not overgeneralize high-dose animal studies to specific cultivar or humans.
